description:
In `fsharp_mapper.ml`, `find_extractor` returns `Some "catseye-fsharp-extractor"` for the PATH fallback without checking if the binary exists. The subsequent `Unix.open_process_in` will fail with a confusing shell error.

Fix: Use `Unix.system "which catseye-fsharp-extractor > /dev/null 2>&1"` or `Sys.file_exists` on common PATH locations to verify the binary exists before returning `Some`. Return `None` if not found, and let the caller produce a clear error message.
title: F# mapper: find_extractor PATH fallback should verify binary exists
